 Otorbi suffers hamstring blow after 11 minutes at Mestalla 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article David Otorbi lasted only 11 minutes before being stretchered off during the match between Valencia and Villarreal at Mestalla. According to AS, he suffered a right hamstring injury.
 During a burst down the left touchline, he felt a sharp pain and went to ground, unable to continue.
 OneFootball Videos
 It was his first start under Javier Aguirre, the stadium fell silent as his debut was cut short. He had worked his way into the XI.
 He left to a rousing ovation, with supporters chanting his name.
 Club medics assessed the initial damage and will run further tests to determine an exact diagnosis. The early signs were not encouraging, his pain was obvious across the ground and his expression showed his discomfort.
 Source: AS
